claims: As of April 12, 2026, Rory McIlroy’s career earnings on the PGA Tour have surpassed $114 million.
As of April 12, 2026, Rory McIlroy is second only to Tiger Woods in PGA Tour career earnings.
Rory McIlroy’s 2026 Masters win included a $4.5 million prize.
Rory McIlroy’s 2026 Masters win brought his PGA Tour total to approximately $114.69 million.
As of April 2026, Rory McIlroy’s total PGA Tour earnings are approximately $114.7 million.
Rory McIlroy’s 2025 Masters payout was $4.2 million.
As of April 2026, Rory McIlroy’s all-time ranking in PGA Tour earnings is second behind Tiger Woods.
Tiger Woods has over $120 million in PGA Tour earnings.
Rory McIlroy has earned tens of millions from FedEx Cup success.
Rory McIlroy has three FedEx Cup titles.
Rory McIlroy collected $35 million from the PGA Tour’s Player Impact Program (PIP) in the first four years of its existence.
Rory McIlroy has secured over €60 million ($68M+) on the DP World Tour (formerly European Tour).
Rory McIlroy has a long-term deal with Nike.
